description: This file defines classes and functions for managing and displaying tool configurations and summaries within an Android application, including JSON serialization/deserialization, configuration loading, and string processing.

classes.name: ToolDisplayActionSpec
classes.description: Serializable data class representing an action specification with optional label and detail keys.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySpec
classes.description: Serializable data class representing a tool display specification with optional emoji, title, label, detail keys, and actions.

classes.name: ToolDisplayConfig
classes.description: Serializable data class representing the overall configuration including version, fallback spec, and tools map.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: Data class representing a summarized display of a tool, including methods for generating display lines.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns a ToolDisplaySummary based on context, name, args, and meta, applying configuration and string processing.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the tool display configuration from assets, with caching and fallback.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a title string from a tool name by formatting and capitalization.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes a verb string by trimming and replacing underscores.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detail string for 'read' actions based on args.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Extracts the path detail from args.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Finds the first non-blank rendered value from args based on a list of keys.

methods.name: valueForPath
methods.description: Retrieves a nested JsonElement from args based on a dot-separated path.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a JsonElement into a string, with handling for primitives, arrays, and size limits.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces home directory paths in a string with '~' for brevity.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to get string content from a JsonElement.

methods.name: asNumberOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to parse a JsonElement as a Double.
